channel.title: The Ottawa Citizen - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Ottawa Citizen (ottawacitizen.com)

item.title: What happens when you don't die on time?
item.description: Hélène Campbell was supposed to be long dead by now. She emptied her bucket list, bank account — and, at 34, is left to wonder: “What next?” And she's not alone.

item.title: Let's make a ByWard Market we can be proud of | Opinion
item.description: This is a historic opportunity to restore the Market to its historic place as the jewel of our city, writes Mayor Mark Sutcliffe.

item.title: Developer to perform mercury testing on former golf course, City of Ottawa says
item.description: Work using heavy equipment at the former golf course started in January.

item.title: OC Transpo LRT repairs expected to continue 'through this evening': Charter
item.description: O Train Line 1 closed east of uOttawa station due to damages to the system's overhead power system in the Wednesday's freezing rain storm.

item.title: Ottawa Senators will receive No. 32 overall pick in NHL draft after Gary Bettman modifies penalty
item.description: The Ottawa Senators had their penalty for the botched deal with Vegas Golden Knights for winger Evgenii Dadonov modified.

item.title: Ottawa police arrest two, seize drugs in raids
item.description: Police seized 25 grams of cocaine, more than 20 grams of crack cocaine, hydromorphone pills, as well as cash.

item.title: Alfred man, 22, faces child-luring charges
item.description: Ottawa police say there's concern other victims are involved in the alleged offences that occurred between March and December 2024.

item.title: More than 30 Petawawa troops suffer frostbite during Arctic exercise
item.description: Several Canadian soldiers were hospitalized in Fairbanks, Alaska.

item.title: 'Not just a cut, it's a decimation': Union leaders slam government cuts
item.description: Public sector unions warned a parliamentary committee that job cuts will impact services Canadians rely on.

item.title: Some Ottawa residents may go more than three weeks without garbage pickup
item.description: A gap between the city's current and new curbside collection contracts is causing a prolonged period without garbage pickup for some residents.
